title: BALSAM: A Platform for Benchmarking Arabic Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as a text classification task ("Stereotype Detection") within the broader 78-task BALSAM benchmark suite.

Qualitatively evaluated through human manual review of random dataset samples to identify culturally inappropriate contexts, unintended biases, and cultural misalignments arising from translated English datasets.
Assessed via a "Gender Rewriting" text manipulation task to evaluate the models' ability to accurately handle gendered morphological and syntactic transitions in Arabic.
